newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KGHM copper concern IPO seen in June.
newsitem.headline: Polish KGHM copper concern IPO seen in June.

text.p: The initial public offering of the Polish KGHM copper concern is likely to be in June but the structure of the issue has not been decided yet, an official of the Union Bank of Switzerland, advising in the sale, said.

The corporate finance head at the UBS Warsaw office, Rafal Sosna, said the final decisions on the foreign and domestic tranches were likely to be made by the treasury ministry and the advising consortium at the turn of January and February.
Sosna made the statement to Poland's Rzeczpospolita daily and his office confirmed it to Reuters on Wednesday. @
"Decisions on the structure of the issue, meaning the size of the domestic and foreign tranches as well as the potential capital rise through a new share issue, have not been taken yet," Sosna said.
"They will be made at the turn of January and February. The issue itself is planned for June and this date seems realistic,"
